audit.why: 57.56% over 714 games — the best row in this slice. Levels 1-3 are a poke skill check against a 1200-range Mistral Bolt; 4-6 are Annie's; 2+ items goes back to Vex.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].why sold the 2+ item row as an Annie spike while win[6] and the packet chart give it to Vex.
audit.why: Shadow Surge reaches 3000 range at rank 3 on a 100s cooldown, so late-game she picks the fight from outside anything Annie can answer at 600 range.
audit.corrected: phases[6].why rewritten to Vex's late-game reach.

audit.whatIsWrong: Personal Space was treated throughout as the fear ability, and 'Doombringer' was named as a Vex ability.
audit.why: Personal Space is a 475-range shield plus nearby damage on 16/15/14/13/12s — the fear belongs to Doom 'n Gloom (P). That inversion hides the decisive interaction: her shield eats a stocked-stun burst, so it has to be forced out with a Q before you commit. 'Doombringer' is not in the kit at all. And because Doom 'n Gloom exists to fear and interrupt dashers, it is her weakest button into an Annie who has none — Molten Shield's move-speed burst is not a dash.
audit.corrected: Shield mechanic and cooldown written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, wants.you[2], spikes[2] and breakdown.carry; Doombringer removed from whys[6], spikes[3] and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read 'Skill' against win[] Skill x3, Annie x3, Vex.
audit.why: win[] matches the packet levelChart; the phases layer never got the last four rows.
audit.corrected: Four phases[N].side edits proposed as one group.

edits.before: Late Annie flips fights with one button: flash-Tibbers the clump, peel with the bear, and re-stock off the chaos.
edits.after: Vex edges 2+ items: Gloom-fed bolts and a 3000-range Shadow Surge pick the fight from outside your bear.

edits.before: - Vex Personal Space (Fear): matchup-defining — Shield + AoE fear that punishes dashes — never dash onto her while her passive glows. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Molten Shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Personal Space is a shield on 16s at rank 1 — force it out with a Q before you spend the stocked stun, or your burst lands on absorb. - Doom 'n Gloom fears and interrupts dashers; you have no dash, so it is her weakest button here.

edits.before: Shield + AoE fear that punishes dashes — never dash onto her while her passive glows. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Personal Space is a 16s shield — bait it with a Q first, then spend the stocked stun into her real health bar.

edits.before: Carry through the one button — Flash-Tibbers on two is a won fight; your whole game is engineering the radius.
edits.after: Carry by baiting the shield: Q out Personal Space first, so stun-Tibbers lands on health and not on absorb.

edits.before: If Vex opens the score, reset expectations and respect Personal Space (Fear) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q refunds and stay relevant through stocked-stun threat.
edits.after: If Vex opens the score, respect the 1200 range on Mistral Bolt and farm the back of the wave. Bait Personal Space with a Q before any commit, keep the refunds coming, and hold the glow for her step-up.

edits.before: Avoid unnecessary dashes/flashes near her so you don't eat a bonus Doom fear-execute proc
edits.after: Force out her Personal Space shield with a Q before you spend the stun on her

edits.before: Your burst combo kills her before she can safely land Personal Space poke stacks, since she's just as squishy as you and has no defensive tool against a landed stun.
edits.after: Your burst combo kills her before Gloom stacks matter, and her only defensive tool is a 16-second Personal Space shield — force it out first and she is as squishy as you are.

edits.before: Vex's late-game Gloom/Doombringer burst scaling overtakes Annie's damage once she has a full mage item
edits.after: Vex's late Gloom-fed burst and Shadow Surge reach overtake Annie's damage once she has a full mage item

edits.before: Vex's Doombringer damage amp against dashers/CC-immune targets and her fear uptime scale into a genuine threat if she gets ahead in items, tipping the late lane read back toward her.
edits.after: Vex's Gloom-amplified damage and the 3000-range Shadow Surge dive scale into a genuine burst threat if she gets ahead in items, tipping the late lane read back toward her.

edits.before: Once Vex stacks a burst AP item her Gloom-empowered Mistral Bolts plus Doombringer amp start threatening a one-shot on you if she's fed, so the late lane favor shifts to her if the game goes long without you closing it out first.
edits.after: Once Vex stacks a burst AP item her Gloom-empowered Mistral Bolts and a Shadow Surge dive from as far as 3000 range start threatening a one-shot if she's fed, so the late favor shifts to her if the game goes long without you closing it.

notes: focus.text still reads 'Vex Personal Space (Fear)', which names the wrong ability for the fear; I left it because the correct token would be a different tracked ability and that is a champion-level focus decision rather than a text fix — flagging it in questionsForUser. Whether Flash counts as a dash for Doom 'n Gloom's mark is not in Riot's text, so I asserted nothing about it and removed the claim rather than restating it. breakdown.early/mid/wave/late, tradeGood, tradeBad and loading remain Annie-generic templates.
